purpose: Design of target resolution, DLID assignment, change-set detection and ToC building: how index targets are fixed, IDs verified, candidates generated and committed atomically.
summary: Input/output and execution boundary of a ToC build, which never rewrites index target documents
Argument rules and target resolution: key, paths, dirs, excludes, target-file, pattern expansion, fixed exclusions, symlinks
ID check: documents lacking a doc_link_id or with duplicates are excluded from the confirmed list and reported
DLID assignment operation: duplicate original selection, issuing IDs and section IDs, DLID-only writes, verification
Change-set detection for documents and sections (added, removed, moved, heading changed, body changed)
Move detection via a per-key record file kept until the confirmed ToC is published
Information acquisition: reuse of document info, AI generation only when needed, candidate validation, atomic publish
Completion output: counts on stdout, full details in a detail file under .temp
Write units using os.replace, no locks, and recovery on rerun after failure
tasks: Implementing or modifying index-docs build scripts
Implementing the embed-dlid DLID assignment operation
Designing target specification parsing and expansion
Reviewing ToC build candidate validation and publication
Designing completion result output and detail files
title: DES-005 対象確定・DLID 付与・[ToC]構築設計
